normalization_plan.reason: The destination parameter only defines the credit target of FYBYR.transfer, so it collapses into the transfer function node.
The amount parameter is used only as the argument of safeSub/safeAdd inside FYBYR.transfer.
The spender parameter is only a mapping key written by FYBYR.approve.
The tokens parameter is only the allowance value stored by FYBYR.approve.
The from parameter selects the debited balance and allowance slot of FYBYR.transferFrom.
The to parameter selects the credited balance inside FYBYR.transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the transferred amount handled by FYBYR.transferFrom.
The spender parameter directly determines the target of the unsafe external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is both stored in allowed and forwarded to the unsafe external call in approveAndCall.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the unsafe external receiveApproval call.
The tokenAddress parameter is the untrusted contract address used by the unsafe external transfer call.
The tokens parameter is passed straight into the unsafe external ERC20 transfer call.
The _newOwner parameter is the only value written by Owned.transferOwnership and is later consumed by acceptOwnership.
